title: Perfect localizing generation detects a natural isomorphism on all shifts
statement: Let X be a scheme with the displayed derived categories and a triangulated quasi-coherent object property [def-pc-derived-category]. Let F,G:D_QCoh(X)→D be exact functors to a pretriangulated category, equipped with separately chosen coherent integer shifts, preserving u-sized coproducts. For any natural τ:F→G, if τ is invertible at every shift of every perfect object [def-pc-perfect-complex], then perfectLocalizingClosure X [def-pc-perfect-localizing-closure] is contained in the object property on D_QCoh(X) saying that τ is invertible on every integer shift. Perfection itself is stable under isomorphisms and integer shifts.

source.place: Tag 09IS, the defining localizing infimum; Tag 08C3, local bounded strictly-perfect models. The proved perfect_iso and perfect_shift helpers are extracted with attribution from PerfectTwoOutOfThree.

proof.text: For perfection under isomorphism compose every local presentation with the restriction of the inverse isomorphism. For a shift n, shift each local strictly-perfect complex and subtract n from its two bounds; transport its comparison by the restriction and quotient shift isomorphisms.

Apply sInf_le to the candidate object property on D_QCoh(X) of invertibility on all shifts. Its perfect case is the hypothesis. Its isomorphism, shift and retract clauses use the corresponding generic shift-saturated closure lemmas.

Lift any ambient distinguished triangle with quasi-coherent objects to the full D_QCoh subcategory. Identify its image with the ambient triangle using the inclusion shift isomorphism, and invoke the generic all-shifts five-term lemma. For coproducts lift the ambient cofan and its universal property into the full subcategory; the generic preserved-colimit lemma establishes its all-shifts invertibility clause.

lean.statement:
theorem perfectClosure_le_isoOnAllShifts
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [(schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).IsTriangulated]
    {D : Type*} [Category D] [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ] [Preadditive D]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive] [Pretriangulated D]
    (F G : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ D)
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [G.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated] [G.IsTriangulated]
    (τ : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : ∀ J : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) F)
    (hG : ∀ J : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) G)
    (hperfect : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      Scheme.perfectSubcategory X E.obj → isoOnAllShifts F G τ E) :
    perfectLocalizingClosure X ≤ isoOnAllShifts F G τ
